keyword: how often is the world baseball classic
claims: The World Baseball Classic (WBC) is generally held every three to four years.
The official frequency of the WBC is every 3-4 years.
The 2021 WBC schedule was delayed to 2023 by the COVID-19 pandemic.
The next WBC following the 2023 tournament is taking place in March 2026.
The gap between the 2023 WBC tournament and the next WBC is three years.
The next WBC tournament is March 5–17, 2026.
Previous WBC tournaments were held in 2006, 2009, 2013, 2017, 2023.
The 2026 WBC host cities are Houston, Tokyo, Miami, and San Juan, Puerto Rico.
